title: The Role of Physician Integration in Alternative Payment Models: The Case of the Comprehensive Joint Replacement Program
eligible_reason: Single adoption date: cjr_trtmt = 1 if cjr_trtmt_grp > 0 & fiscal_year >= 2017 for every CJR hospital (Hospital_Level_Analyses.do lines 145-146; FY2016 dropped from estimation). Table 1/2: areg y i.fiscal_year [hospital characteristics: gaf cola dshpct ... ln_discharges adc pac, pac x year, integration x year] c.cjr_trtmt [x continuous integration measures], absorb(provider_id) [pweight = IPTW x discharges] cluster(msa). One cohort, plus time-varying controls, inverse-probability-of-treatment weights, and continuous integration-by-treatment interactions (the headline estimand). cjr_mand_trtmt / cjr_opt_trtmt (FY2017 vs FY2018) are defined but not used in any regression.
design_notes: Hospital-fiscal-year panel FY2013-2018 of CJR-eligible IPPS hospitals in the 196 selection MSAs (CMS randomized MSAs into CJR starting April 2016). Table 5 regresses reconciliation payments on integration within CJR MSAs (cross-sectional). Patient-level analyses (felm on HCUP SID discharges, R) use patient controls and are not shippable.
data_files_note: README: final hospital-level analysis data shipped; patient-level HCUP SID data and proprietary Care Precise inputs not shipped (exemption 4f); patient-level code and log provided.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). CMS CJR treatment begins in a single period for all treated hospitals; not staggered.
